title: OHIF build profile (ohif.config.json)
description: Build-time inputs for a customized OHIF build, selected with OHIF_ENV=<path-to-this-file>. Every key supplies a DEFAULT for the matching environment variable, so a profile replaces a pile of `cross-env A=1 B=2 rsbuild build` script lines. An environment variable that is already set always wins over the profile, which keeps one-off CI overrides working. This is the same file the `pnpm create ohif` workspace template commits, so a workspace's manifest and its build profile are one artifact.

pluginConfig.description: Path to the pluginConfig.json this build should use (env: PLUGIN_CONFIG). Relative paths resolve against the directory holding this profile. Defaults to platform/app/pluginConfig.json. Declare a `root` inside that file if its `directory` values should resolve against something other than the OHIF repo root.

appConfig.description: Runtime configuration copied to dist as app-config.js (env: APP_CONFIG). Either a path relative to platform/app/public ('config/hospital.js'), or a './'-prefixed path resolved against this profile's directory ('./config/app-config.js') for a deployment that owns its app config outside the OHIF checkout.

publicUrl.description: Route the viewer is served from (env: PUBLIC_URL). Must start and end with '/'.

htmlTemplate.description: Filename under platform/app/public/html-templates to use as the HTML entry (env: HTML_TEMPLATE).

entryTarget.description: Alternative JS entry module (env: ENTRY_TARGET). Relative paths resolve against the directory holding this profile.

ohifVersion.description: create-ohif workspace harness only: the OHIF tag the gitignored .ohif/ checkout is pinned to. Ignored by the build.

plugins.description: create-ohif workspace harness only: workspace-owned plugin package names the harness links into the checkout. Ignored by the build — what the build compiles in comes from `pluginConfig`.
